facts.claim_en: The EEOC's Mobile Local Office timeliness page says a person in Alabama has 180 days from the date of alleged harm to file a charge with the EEOC against an employer with 15 or more employees, for discrimination based on race, color, national origin, sex, religion or disability.
facts.claim_es: La página de plazos de la oficina Mobile Local Office de la EEOC indica que una persona en Alabama tiene 180 días desde la fecha del daño alegado para presentar un cargo ante la EEOC contra un empleador con 15 o más empleados, por discriminación por raza, color, origen nacional, sexo, religión o discapacidad.
facts.source_name: U.S. EEOC, Mobile Local Office: Timeliness
facts.quote: Mobile Local Office Information In the State of Alabama, an individual has 180 days from the date of alleged harm to file a charge with this office against an employer with 15 or more employees for discrimination based on race, color, national origin, sex, religion, and/or disability.

facts.claim_en: The EEOC says the general deadline to file a charge is 180 calendar days from the day the discrimination took place, extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law against employment discrimination on the same basis.
facts.claim_es: La EEOC indica que el plazo general para presentar un cargo es de 180 días calendario desde el día de la discriminación, y se extiende a 300 días calendario si una agencia estatal o local aplica una ley contra la discriminación laboral por el mismo motivo.
facts.source_name: U.S. EEOC, Time Limits for Filing a Charge
facts.quote: In general, you need to file a charge within 180 calendar days from the day the discrimination took place. The 180 calendar day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits employment discrimination on the same basis.

facts.claim_en: The EEOC says that in harassment cases, the charge must be filed within 180 or 300 days of the last incident of harassment, and it looks at all incidents when investigating.
facts.claim_es: La EEOC indica que en casos de acoso el cargo debe presentarse dentro de 180 o 300 días del último incidente, y que al investigar revisa todos los incidentes.
facts.source_name: U.S. EEOC, Time Limits for Filing a Charge
facts.quote: In harassment cases, you must file your charge within 180 or 300 days of the last incident of harassment, although we will look at all incidents of harassment when investigating your charge
